acceptance_predicates.description: The development TUI installer resolves a conventional user-owned rustup Cargo shim and its selected Cargo/rustc toolchain even when user-owned shim ancestors are group-writable.
Accepted group-writable development paths produce an explicit development-only warning in human and JSON output.
World-writable, non-user-owned, symlinked-parent, escaping, missing, or malformed toolchain paths remain typed hard failures.
Stable and production installation retain the strict trust policy and never inherit the development exception.
Exact paired ASB/asb-tui install, status, bare launch, upgrade, and removal pass with the host's conventional rustup layout.

definition_of_done: Exact independently reviewed implementation is merged on protected ASB main.
Focused resolver/rustc tests, paired installed-entrypoint qualification, and exact-head hosted checks pass.
Post-merge required checks are terminal green and the owning TUI blockers are requalified.

inputs.description: AR-1634 Cargo shim resolver and AR-1636 trusted rustc propagation.

outputs.description: Warning-labelled development toolchain acceptance without weakening stable or production trust.

gates.description: Positive 0775 user-owned shim, standard private shim, and hard rejection cases pass.
Exact ASB/asb-tui installed lifecycle passes on the affected host layout.
Exact reviewed head and post-merge required CI pass.
